method: Existing normalized host npz features and normalized raw phone f32; same float32 matrix multiplication and stable arg-sort as evaluate_accuracy. Cosines use float64.
scope: All 5925 FP32-baseline images and 110 shared dynamic-INT8 text prompts; no model inference and no mixed-image device output read.
host_score_reproduction: Entire predicted_class arrays and Top1 counts must equal saved host accuracy results.

phone_score_reproduction.source: Independent Top1 counts supplied by the parent task before this diagnostic
